task_description: Fix the production 'User not found.' bug (in-memory user store is empty on a fresh Vercel serverless isolate after login) by replacing the three in-memory module-singleton stores (users, books, reviews) with hosted-Supabase-Postgres-backed implementations behind the UNCHANGED store interfaces. Backend is selected at construction time: Supabase when SUPABASE_URL + SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY are present, otherwise fall back to the existing in-memory stores so build/tests/lint/dev stay green keyless. Add pure mapper unit tests, and update .env.example + README.

review.followups: Non-blocking issue #1 (admin client not memoized in production) FIXED in commit 64d7991. Non-blocking issue #2 (Supabase store classes lack a live-DB test guard - ownership .eq filters and maybeSingle undefined-on-no-row) left as-is: intentional given no live DB available; semantics are structurally guaranteed by the pure mappers + query shape.

verification.summary: All 3 features complete. Keyless verification green: npm run lint clean, npm run typecheck clean, npm test = 93 tests / 16 files pass (79 baseline + 14 new pure mapper tests), npm run build succeeds with all routes registered. Test quality: mappers.ts is pure (no I/O) and mappers.test.ts exercises real object<->row round-trip, null-column->undefined-property, bigint->number, and camelCase->snake_case column placement - each would fail if the mapping logic were reverted. Supabase stores verified to preserve exact interface semantics: ownership enforced in-query via .eq('user_id', userId) for BookStore.get/saveAnalysis, saveProfile/saveAnalysis return undefined via .maybeSingle() on no match (fixes the onboarding 404 'User not found.' root cause when durable), list orders created_at desc. Backend selected at construction with in-memory fallback when SUPABASE_* env absent, so existing 79 tests (seeding real singletons) stay green keyless. No Dockerfile so docker_build skipped.
